scope: Config/schema/downloader and representative recent scout implementations. Does not certify every V1-V95 or all formal engine paths.

findings.finding: Recent scout economics are specified in standalone scripts/specifications, not driven by config/research.toml. No single central setting governs these outcomes.
findings.effect: Comparability and promotion require explicit per-run settings; changing central risk/cost config will not repair these tests.

findings.finding: Date-only Alpaca end is midnight UTC; static20 runner requests2025-12-31 and omits that entire New York trading session.
findings.effect: Confirmed explanation for last-day unknowns in V94/V95. Not an explanation for multi-year losses. Preserve historical artifacts; future requests need explicit session-end semantics and completeness checks.

findings.finding: Bar tests assume3bps each side for SPY and5bps for stocks; V40 crosses recorded bid/ask plus1bp each side and fixed fee approximations. These are not one calibrated historical fee schedule.
findings.effect: Absolute net results depend on execution assumptions. V40 observed ask/bid alone loses; the new stock-reversal later-period gross path also loses.

findings.finding: Latest stock rules intentionally enter one hour after completed feature bars. Static universe and retrospective adjusted prices require separate PIT controls.
findings.effect: Tests of delayed rules, not proof against faster mechanisms; universe bias can overstate performance. Price adjustments within a day cancel in percentage returns, but cross-session features need care.

findings.finding: Earlier version-specific frequency, every-year, every-side and action-agreement gates are not interchangeable with economic loss.
findings.effect: Rejected-gate counts cannot be represented as counts of money-losing hypotheses.

findings.finding: Yahoo downloader falls back to raw close if adjusted-close field is absent.
findings.effect: Potential silent benchmark-definition change; no evidence established that this fallback occurred in the current cached SPY series. Current benchmark remains labeled a total-return proxy.
